card.name: Strength words before CYP inhibitor or inducer
card.fires_on: Strength or type words such as moderate, potent, time-dependent right before inhibitor or inducer in CYP3A enzyme interaction text. Also commas and linking words in lists of inhibition, induction or competition.

modes.label: Strength before inhibitor/inducer
modes.description: An adjective like potent or moderate that describes how strongly a drug affects a CYP enzyme.
modes.example: Itraconazole and ketoconazole are<< potent>> inhibitors as well as substrates of C

modes.label: Linking words in enzyme lists
modes.description: A comma, hyphen or 'of' inside phrases about inhibition, induction or dual inducers of CYP enzymes.
modes.example: Moderate or Strong Dual Inducers<< of>> CYP2C9 and CYP
